subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should the pinned, locked PR-limit announcement remain open as the live contributor-policy notice now that current docs and automation already enforce the 20-open-PR cap?
rationale: Source cleanup is not needed, but closing or unpinning a maintainer-reopened policy announcement changes contributor-facing repository administration.

options.title: Keep the pinned notice
options.body: Leave this issue open, pinned, and locked as the canonical announcement while the 20-PR policy remains active.

options.title: Close after unpinning
options.body: Unpin and close this issue as admin cleanup because CONTRIBUTING.md and v2026.6.11 already carry the same policy.

options.title: Move rationale into docs only
options.body: Fold any remaining rationale into CONTRIBUTING.md or public docs and use Discord for exception coordination instead of an open issue.

recommendation.title: Keep the pinned notice
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open, pinned, and locked as the canonical announcement while the 20-PR policy remains active.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman renamed the notice to 20, repinned it, and reopened it after the original docs PR closed it.
